not_a_registered_execution: This proposal fixes cohort and raw messages, but a source-reviewed implementation, resource closure, tokenizer IDs and reviewer protocol must be frozen before any future model call.
scientific_question: Do bounded one-token lexical proposals provide any individually source-preserving alternatives without the autoregressive JSON failure mode observed in native-v4?
receiver_contract_boundary: Future source-indexed public template and candidate bank are shared document state, not a universal general dictionary or a compressed dictionary transmitted by the key.

cohort.selection: First3 maximal ASCII-letter runs with >=4letters, all lowercase, excluding the literal STOP list in the pinned metadata builder; no adjacent Unicodealnum, apostrophe, underscore or Unicode dash. These are proposal targets, not accepted semantic slots.
cohort.absent_positions: Retain absent slot opportunities; no replacement source or position.

proposed_model.forward_inputs: Apply exact pinned chat template with add_generation_prompt=True to saved raw messages. Entire source precedes the completion point, so both original left and right contexts are observed.
proposed_model.tie_break: descending finite float32 logit, then ascending token ID
proposed_model.probability_claim: Logits rank vocabulary-piece proposals; no full-word completion probability is claimed.

candidate_pipeline: Save all50 token IDs, logits and exact decoded bytes before any acceptance filtering; missing/invalid probe is a retained failure.

Decode each single token with pinned tokenizer, skip_special_tokens=False and clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False. Keep only exact ASCII lowercase letters optionally preceded by one ASCII space; remove only that one leading space.

Require resulting standalone word string to be in the publicv1 member alphabet (data/shared_dictionary_recovery_v1.json, sha256a6266ac3c120a081970e3b74024b8618f2d69c0c1ad98e812135f30d92343239). Original class membership is not reused as a synonym decision. This lexical spelling check excludes many subwords; it does not prove contextual validity.
Reject unchanged original and normalized duplicates; preserve every rejection and its earliest reason.

Review each mechanically surviving single replacement in the complete original source for contextual POS, morphology, entity/reference, temporal/numeric/modal/degree constraints and source-supported meaning. Reject uncertainty and reviewer disagreement. Never use NLI alone as acceptance.

Choose at most8 alternatives by original top50 rank from the provisionally agreed candidates; record candidates beyond the fixed cap. Code serializes the bank with original word included separately; model never generates JSON.
Freeze provisional public bank and all review labels before any payload/key-dependent selection. Single-candidate review does not approve simultaneous combinations.

review.reference: Full exact source excerpt; source-supported is not externally verified true.
review.prelaunch_gate: Record evaluator identities/instructions and adjudication policy before candidate generation; no posthoc relaxation to increase acceptance.

future_invariant.parse: MaximalASCIIletter runs plus exact intervening literal runs; use publictemplate word_run_index, never original byte offsets to index variable-length stego.
future_invariant.validation: Same run count; exact literal runs and unselected cores; selected core belongs to publicposition-specificbank.
future_invariant.canonicalization: C_i(s) restores the publictemplate original core at every selected run. Thus C_i(s)=T_i for every validated member of the Cartesian product.
future_invariant.eligibility: E_i and ordering derive solely from frozen publictemplate/bank; neither candidate spelling nor secret payload chooses whether a slot exists.
future_invariant.key_role: Key+nonce+sourceID+bankdigest+slotID deterministically permutes options and labels. It does not create options or compress document-specific public resources.
future_invariant.semantic_limit: Canonicalization is a synchronization proof only. Joint semantic closure of slot combinations remains unproved and must be checked before a future codec.

capacity.warning: Even the design upper bound cannot carry a framed8bit message; this pilot diagnoses lexical candidate quality, not practical delivery.

must_report: per-source observed raw capacity if banks exist
accounting.amortization: Report M=1 and M=100 uses of the same frozen publicbank; reuse changes setup cost, not per-text capacity or semantic evidence.
accounting.notes: No wire/header/nonce is produced in this diagnostic; those values remain null until a separately frozen codec exists.

stop_rules.unknown_or_backend_error: Stop remaining model calls; preserve attempted/unknown/not_attempted counts.
stop_rules.mechanical_or_semantic_zero: Record zero accepted alternatives and continue fixed cohort; do not replace source or raise topK.

postpilot_decision_rule.zero_provisionally_supported_alternative: Retain the negative result; do not widen topK, replace sources or launch a codec under this ID.
postpilot_decision_rule.positive_alternatives: Report only individual-candidate support and observed bounded bank sizes. A separately preregistered all-position/joint-compatibility and public-setup-cost study is needed before any practical codec; do not select only successful sources.
